1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3 Bb4+ 4.Bd2 a5 5.g.strategy: Completes White's own fianchetto, which prepares to castle and opposes the long diagonal that Black's bishop will take. White keeps solid and waits to decide how to meet the pressure on d4 and c4.

Completes the fianchetto: the two bishops face each other on the long diagonal. Black has gained queenside space with the a-pawn and plans to trade the b4 bishop for a knight when it reaches c3, which strengthens the grip on the light squares.
1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3 Bb4+ 4.Bd2 a5 5.g.name: Queen's Indian Defence: Yates Variation
